lines.C01: Still stacking pillows just to read in bed?
lines.C02: Meet CosyLift – it makes the bed you already have electrically adjustable.
lines.C03: No new bed needed – it slides right under your mattress.
lines.C04: Work, read or simply relax – whisper-quiet, up to 59 degrees.
lines.C06: Double bed? Use two CosyLifts – each side moves on its own, or both together with the sync cable.
lines.C07: CosyLift. Make more of your bed.
